A.text: Nitrogen is unreactive due to the absence of lone pairs in the molecule.

B.text: Aqueous ammonia contains both $\text{NH}_3\text{(aq)}$ and $\text{NH}_4^{+}\text{(aq)}$. The $\text{NH}_4^{+}\text{(aq)}$ ion is a Brønsted–Lowry acid.

C.text: High temperatures are needed to supply the energy to break the strong double bonds in nitrogen molecules when they react.

D.text: Atmospheric $\text{SO}_2$ reacts with unburnt hydrocarbons to form a component of photochemical smog.
